pinRationale: Pinned to HEAD at the time this matrix was hardened. Gradle 9.7.1 runs natively on a JDK-21 runner (no discovery fallback needed). Smallest/simplest repo in the matrix: no explicit JDK config anywhere, so jdkVersion falls all the way through to the AGP-minimum-JDK floor.
groundTruthMethod: gradleVersion/androidSdkVersion/moduleCount were confirmed by reading build files at the pinned commit (no multi-segment includes here, so no implicit-parent surprises). NDK/CMake absence was confirmed by searching the tree for externalNativeBuild / CMakeLists.txt / Android.mk — see #38, which established that AGP's android.ndkVersion default is not evidence of native code. jdkVersion and androidBuildToolsVersion are AGP's own deterministic resolution, not literal build-file values — confirmed by running `gradlezilla generate --dry-run --format json` against this exact pinned checkout twice: once with no Android SDK present at all, once with a full local SDK. Both runs produced byte-identical values for these fields, proving they are a function of the pinned AGP/Gradle version, not of whatever happens to be installed on the runner.

jdkVersion.source: verified run: extractionMetadata.jdkVersionSource="agpMinimum" — no explicit sourceCompatibility/targetCompatibility/jvmTarget/toolchain anywhere in timber/build.gradle, timber-lint/build.gradle, timber-sample/build.gradle, or root build.gradle; AGP 9.4.0 (gradle/libs.versions.toml agp="9.4.0") requires JDK 17+, which resolves

androidSdkVersion.source: gradle/libs.versions.toml: compileSdk = "36", read via libs.versions.compileSdk.get() in timber/build.gradle

androidBuildToolsVersion.source: verified run: not set anywhere in build.gradle files; this is AGP 9.4.0's own default build-tools version

moduleCount.source: settings.gradle: include ':timber', include ':timber-lint', include ':timber-sample' — no multi-segment includes, confirmed by verified run

ndkPresent.source: no externalNativeBuild configured — no externalNativeBuild.cmake.path or ndkBuild.path on any module, and no CMakeLists.txt / Android.mk anywhere in the tree

androidNdkVersion.source: not emitted. AGP populates android.ndkVersion with its own bundled default on every project, native or not, so that field was never evidence of native code — an earlier revision of this file expected "28.2.13676358" here for exactly that reason. Since #38 gradlezilla emits an NDK only for modules that actually compile native code

androidCmakeVersion.source: not emitted: no module uses externalNativeBuild.cmake
